historical_trial.worker_process_creation: confirmed: worker ran canonical CLI, preflight gate, created runtime-check and saved ordinal 3 reservation
historical_trial.native_model_process_creation: unknown: reservation precedes auth check and native transport construction; no start/completion event was retained

operation_attribution.exact_failing_operation: not established; no stack frame, stage, errno or winerror was retained
operation_attribution.controller_boundary: The reported exception was caught by the controller outer try. Child exceptions do not directly cross the subprocess boundary. Child nonzero exit is translated to cli_nonzero; published child fatal would remain in the active ledger, which instead stayed null.
operation_attribution.candidate_operations: Controller finish/safe performs direct original/prior/current record reads and process polling/cleanup. Direct record I/O is a plausible candidate; the specific read, replace or OS call cannot be selected from this record.
operation_attribution.before_after_boundary: After worker subprocess creation and reservation; before/after native model subprocess creation remains unknown.
operation_attribution.os_permission_denial: PermissionError alone does not establish an ACL denial, Windows sharing violation, denied path or provider failure. No OS permission or security setting was changed.

confirmed_harness_defects: Writer used the one-byte lock and os.replace, while controller state() read the JSON without that lock.
Counts used row.get(native_process_starts,0), turning absent completion metadata into a false zero-start implication.
Only reservation and finalization were persisted; interruption between them lost the native-start boundary.
The controller retained only exception class, without a safe operation/stage or numeric OS error context.
Outer fixture cleanup was confirmed, but a separate native temporary working directory was not individually manifested.

controlled_reproduction.scope: fresh owned synthetic file only; no provider, user credential/session/log path or permission-setting change
controlled_reproduction.operation: read handle left open while a separate writer replaces the same JSON
controlled_reproduction.interpretation: This proves a concrete Windows file-sharing failure mode in the old protocol, not that it caused the historical controller PermissionError.

fixes.TrialRecord: Opt-in replacement metadata helper: reader and writer acquire the same OS lock before opening JSON; atomic write and fsync remain, failed .pending evidence is preserved without automatic deletion/replay.
fixes.safe_failure: Operation plus permission category, errno and winerror only; messages, filenames, credentials and traceback text are excluded.
fixes.summary: Missing or incomplete native-start evidence is null/unknown, never default zero; a reserved attempt still consumes one conservative reservation.
fixes.runtime_observer: Opt-in fixed-stage callback around workspace/auth/native start/prompt/result/cleanup. Native creation is observed immediately after supervisor.start, independently of the older calls counter.
fixes.failure_policy: Pre-launch observer failure prevents launch; post-launch failure keeps the started fact, stops the owned supervisor and poisons the instance against replay. No CLI safety flag/auth/billing/ACL changes.
fixes.adoption_limit: Historical launchers and records are frozen. The replacement helper and runtime observer are unit-tested integration points, not an authorization to execute a fresh trial. No actual launch has used them yet.

integration_contract.worker_write: The same TrialRecord.update(action), using the same .lock
integration_contract.failure_report: Record TrialRecordError.safe and the last fixed runtime observation/launch state, not str(error) or a zero default.
integration_contract.private_temp: Any future authorized launcher must put native TEMP/TMP beneath its known owned fixture root or record an owned-path manifest before launch. This review does not search/delete old unidentified temp directories.

preserved_state.third_record_and_original_summary: unchanged; the misleading zero-default interpretation is withdrawn in a separate adjudication
preserved_state.budget: three conservative Codex reservations; two earlier native starts observed, third unknown; Claude zero

cleanup.confirmed: third owned worker job stopped, fixture room closed, token revoked and rejected with 401, server stopped, outer private config/journal directory removed
cleanup.unconfirmed: individual native temporary working-directory deletion; no owned-path manifest was saved

remaining_blockers: historical PermissionError exact operation and cause unresolved
old native temporary working directory individually unidentified
